# Corresponding dependency sources

These exact, unmodified crate archives contain the runtime and build dependency sources for the Windows GUI release. Cargo.lock records their versions and SHA-256 checksums; Cargo downloads and verifies them automatically when building. Download SteamCounter itself from the matching release tag and follow the build instructions in the root README. Rust and the platform compiler/SDK are required build tools.

MPL-2.0 archives are also mirrored in this repository's sources/ folder and additionally available under GPL-3.0-or-later as part of the combined work, under MPL section 3.3. Their original notices and MPL rights are preserved. Shared egui license texts are in this folder. Font sources and licenses are included in epaint_default_fonts.
